name: Protean eGov Technologies Limited
summary: Protean eGov Technologies Limited, together with its subsidiaries, develops and implements citizen-centric and population-scale e-governance solutions and digital public infrastructure in India. It offers PAN and tax deduction, and collection account number issuance; electronic tax deducted at source return processing; online PAN verification; digital enrolment, Electronic National Pension System, and D-Remit; and digital permanent retirement account number generation and integrated payment solutions.
